title: The Episode About the Guruship of Gulab Rai

blocks.text: The woman turns Gulab Rai's own claims against him by asking why anyone should serve a guru who cannot alter what is written. Her bold logic exposes the weakness of performative sanctity, and the whole congregation went into peels of laughter as the exchange humiliates Gulab Rai in public.

Pressed by ridicule, he writes down the promised son's name and temporarily saves face. But the woman's later return, after a different son is born, shows that clever petitioners can keep forcing the pretender to extend blessings he cannot truly command.
The page therefore works as satire rather than miracle story. It mocks false guruship by letting wit, public memory, and village humor puncture a borrowed throne.
